{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the six QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Count how many of them have status 'completed'
qa_completed = qa_rows['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0)

# Total completed orders excluding QA rows
total_completed = df['status'].value_counts().get('completed', 0) - qa_completed

# Print the result
total_completed"}
